purpose: Classify the direct Type-0x4D and Type-0x7B response-child MovementVM entries.

streams.name: ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE7B_RESPONSE_CHILD
decoded: Face toward player and set the initial timer
Terminal actor clear followed by the long negative vertical settle

boundary_basis: The exact Type-0x4D and Type-0x7B response-child template records supply the two movement roots.
MovementDecoder control-flow decode closes the Type-0x4D loop at 12 bytes and the Type-0x7B loop at 134 bytes.
The Type-0x7B owner ends at 0x001217A1, immediately before the independently selected ACTOR_MOVE_TYPE84_SCENE_RESET stream at 0x001217A2.
